displayPattern: Outdoor or indoor control display reads E5 (ASXC/DSXC/GSXC AC and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pump outdoor units with the integrated control module)
meaning: Open fuse: the low-voltage fuse on the control is blown.
diySteps: Technician: check the fuse for continuity and replace it if open
Technician: check the low-voltage wiring for a short and correct it; if there is no short, replace the board
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: a blown fuse usually means a short somewhere in the low-voltage wiring.
sourceTitle: Service and Troubleshooting: ASXC/DSXC/GSXC condensing units and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pumps (RS6200007 r27, hosted by Daikin Comfort)
